olivia: Heads-up: found a flaky panic in the Go generator sample when auth refresh and cancel overlap. Minimal repro uses context.Background() so lifecycle is fuzzy.

prateek: Paste the snippet and stack?

olivia: snippet:
```go
ctx := context.Background()
c := sdk.NewClient(ctx, sdk.Opts{})
it := c.Generator().Stream("p")
for it.Next() { fmt.Println(it.Value().Text) }
if err := it.Err(); err != nil { log.Println(err) }
```
stack: panic: send on closed channel in gen.streamer.push

ben: Likely causes: Background instead of request ctx, and token refresh mutates transport/token source while stream goroutines are active.

ben: Fix plan: update sample to use request-scoped ctx, make iterator own teardown (it.Close()), and serialize token refresh (singleflight). Add integration test that forces refresh + cancel with -race.

olivia: I'll open a small PR updating sample, adding TTL toggle repro script and the test. Filing ticket INF-3337.

dx-bot: INF-3337 created and linked to nightly -race job.

prateek: Also add a short DX note in the Go quickstart: avoid context.Background for streaming generators and show the proper ownership pattern.

olivia: Will do. Thanks all.
